samples.summary: Table-cell image tint still uses the rounded-coordinate intersection the diff just fixed in doc-canvas
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/view/table-renderer.ts:426-446` is the mirror of the code the diff rewrote: it computes `imgX = Math.round(runX)` / `imgY = Math.round(runLineY + line.height - drawHeight)` and then tests `sr.x < imgX + iw && sr.x + sr.width > imgX && ...` against layout-space selection rects — exactly the layout-vs-screen-space comparison that `imageIntersectsSelection` was extracted to prevent (`doc-canvas.ts:130-162`). Images inside table cells therefore keep the half-pixel over-tint of the adjacent neighbour. The new exported helper is not imported there (`grep imageIntersectsSelection` matches only doc-canvas.ts and the new test). Fix belongs in table-renderer.ts: build the unrounded box and call the new helper.

samples.summary: The new stale-selection guard is only in the key handler; the EditorAPI image entry points still use the throwing `doc.getBlock` on the same stale `selectedImage`
samples.evidence: The diff switched the keydown path to `doc.findBlock` specifically because "the peer may have removed the block outright, and the throwing lookup would take this listener down with it" (editor.ts:2259-2262). The other consumers of the same `selectedImage` state were not updated: `EditorAPI.getSelectedImage()` at packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3677 and `EditorAPI.updateSelectedImage()` at :3690 both call `doc.getBlock(selectedImage.blockId)`, which throws (`packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:187 throw new Error('Block not found: ...')`) rather than returning undefined — so their `if (!block) return` lines at 3678/3691 are dead and any API caller reading the image selection after a remote block delete gets an exception instead of null. `selectImageAt` at :3663 has the same dead check. Fix belongs on those three sites (use `findBlock`).

samples.summary: The copy/cut promotion guard excludes only table-cell blocks; header/footer image blocks pass it although `getSelectedBlocks` cannot see them either
samples.evidence: `layout.blockParentMap` is the *body* layout's cell map (built in packages/docs/src/view/layout.ts:379-455); header and footer blocks live in `headerLayout`/`footerLayout` (editor.ts:962-963, merged separately at 1337-1341). A block in the header therefore returns `undefined` from the guard at editor.ts:2345 and gets promoted, but `TextEditor.getSelectedBlocks` resolves the range against `this.getLayout()` = the body layout (text-editor.ts:3684-3695) and returns [] for it, while `deleteSelection` *is* header/footer-aware (text-editor.ts:3432-3441) — the same copy-nothing/delete-anyway asymmetry the guard was written to avoid for cells. Reachability is limited: mouse selection only covers body images (`collectImageRects(layout, ...)`, editor.ts:1854/2389), so this needs `EditorAPI.selectImageAt()` (editor.ts:3662, which does not restrict to body) plus header edit context. Confirming would need a test that selects a header image via the API and presses Cmd+X.

finding.summary: The new stale-selection guard is only in the key handler; the EditorAPI image entry points still use the throwing `doc.getBlock` on the same stale `selectedImage`
finding.evidence: The diff switched the keydown path to `doc.findBlock` specifically because "the peer may have removed the block outright, and the throwing lookup would take this listener down with it" (editor.ts:2259-2262). The other consumers of the same `selectedImage` state were not updated: `EditorAPI.getSelectedImage()` at packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3677 and `EditorAPI.updateSelectedImage()` at :3690 both call `doc.getBlock(selectedImage.blockId)`, which throws (`packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:187 throw new Error('Block not found: ...')`) rather than returning undefined — so their `if (!block) return` lines at 3678/3691 are dead and any API caller reading the image selection after a remote block delete gets an exception instead of null. `selectImageAt` at :3663 has the same dead check. Fix belongs on those three sites (use `findBlock`).

verdict.reason: Verified in the repository. `Doc.getBlock` throws `Error('Block not found: ...')` when the id is absent (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:174-188), while `Doc.findBlock` is the non-throwing variant (document.ts:193-203). The keydown path was moved to the non-throwing lookup with an explicit comment that a peer may delete the block outright (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2259-2266), but the three EditorAPI image entry points still use the throwing lookup on the same `selectedImage` state: `selectImageAt` (editor.ts:3663-3665), `getSelectedImage` (editor.ts:3677-3680) and `updateSelectedImage` (editor.ts:3690-3693). Their `if (!block) return/return null` lines at 3664/3678/3691 are provably dead — `getBlock` never returns a falsy value, it throws — so an API caller reading or patching the image selection after the block disappears gets an exception rather than the documented `null`/no-op contract (interface declared at editor.ts:317-328 as returning `... | null` / `void`). Nothing clears `selectedImage` on remote document change: the only remote-change reconciliation in this file relocates the cursor (editor.ts:359, 976, 3750); `selectedImage` is only nulled by local key/mouse handlers (2264, 2274, 2284, 2301, 2347, 2365, 2541), `clearImageSelection` (3672) and `dispose` (3785) — so the same staleness the new keydown guard was added for reaches these three sites unguarded. This is squarely the blast-radius lane (other consumers of the state/contract the diff hardened were not updated) and the impact — a throw out of a public API on a reachable collaborative path plus dead null-handling — is major.

finding.evidence: `layout.blockParentMap` is the *body* layout's cell map (built in packages/docs/src/view/layout.ts:379-455); header and footer blocks live in `headerLayout`/`footerLayout` (editor.ts:962-963, merged separately at 1337-1341). A block in the header therefore returns `undefined` from the guard at editor.ts:2345 and gets promoted, but `TextEditor.getSelectedBlocks` resolves the range against `this.getLayout()` = the body layout (text-editor.ts:3684-3695) and returns [] for it, while `deleteSelection` *is* header/footer-aware (text-editor.ts:3432-3441) — the same copy-nothing/delete-anyway asymmetry the guard was written to avoid for cells. Reachability is limited: mouse selection only covers body images (`collectImageRects(layout, ...)`, editor.ts:1854/2389), so this needs `EditorAPI.selectImageAt()` (editor.ts:3662, which does not restrict to body) plus header edit context. verdict.reason: Verified in-repo. The copy/cut promotion guard at editor.ts:2345 tests `layout.blockParentMap`, and `layout` is the body layout (editor.ts:960); header/footer layouts are separate (editor.ts:962-963) and their parent maps are merged only into `doc.setBlockParentMap` (editor.ts:1336-1343), never into `layout.blockParentMap`. A header/footer block (top-level or in a header table cell) therefore returns `undefined` and is promoted to a text selection. `getSelectedBlocks` resolves against `this.getLayout()`, wired to the body layout at editor.ts:2172, and returns [] when the block is not in `layout.blocks` (text-editor.ts:3683-3695), so `handleCut` writes an empty payload (text-editor.ts:1215-1218) and then `deleteSelection`, which IS header/footer-aware (text-editor.ts:3429-3445), removes the image inline — the exact copy-nothing/delete-anyway asymmetry the cell exclusion was written to prevent (mirrored by the cell test at test/view/image-copy.test.ts:231-253). Reachability is real though narrower than the mouse path: `EditorAPI.selectImageAt` (editor.ts:3662-3669, declared editor.ts:317) resolves blocks via `doc.getBlock`/`findBlock`, which searches header and footer blocks (model/document.ts:197-200), with no body-only restriction; `imageKeyHandler` runs unconditionally at the top of handleKeyDown (text-editor.ts:838); header edit context is reachable (text-editor.ts:1668-1678, editor.ts:381); and `insertImage` has no editContext guard (editor.ts:3608-3660), so header images can exist. No guard elsewhere clears the image selection on context switch or blocks the path, so none of not-present/already-guarded/out-of-scope applies; a guard with a reachable bypass that deletes content while writing an empty clipboard is major under the blast-radius rubric.
